name: Footage card, text slides in
what: Your footage fills the frame, then spins and tilts away in 3D, shrinking into a tilted card; after a held beat the card shrinks and slides to the left while a bold two-line text slides in from the right in a sideways blur, both dipping a little before they settle.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f9 the card, full frame, spins and tilts in 3D and shrinks to about 80 % (decelerating), f9-f16 it swings back a little and settles tilted; f16-f39 it holds (a slight drift); f40-f51 it shrinks and slides left while the text slides in from the right in a sideways blur (f41-f45), both dipping at f48 and settling by f51; then it holds to the end

tracks.name: spin
tracks.what: the full-frame card spins and tilts in 3D and shrinks to about 80 %

tracks.name: settle
tracks.what: it swings back a little and settles tilted

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the card holds, drifting a hair

tracks.name: slide
tracks.what: the card shrinks and slides to the left, dipping a little before it settles

tracks.name: text
tracks.what: the text slides in from the right in a sideways blur, dips smaller and settles
tracks.easing: accelerating (slow start), then an S-curve settle

tracks.name: hold end
tracks.what: everything still (the footage keeps playing, the film grain moves)
